scientific_object: Korean fact-, discourse- and genre-conditioned document realization; evaluator and generator are instruments, not a consensus/governance theory.

primary_run.scope: Typed clause and assembler interface were mechanically accepted. The modeled Korean prose was overwhelmingly a source-copy, with no triggered feedback and too little expressive transformation to demonstrate a KSGT writing advantage.

synthetic_negative_control.scope: The critic checks lexical anchors and surface indications only; it fails to recognize some predicate-polarity, negation, comparison direction errors.

observed_repairs.result: Model removed invented numerical value and restored original fact.
Model returned correct ID and ordinary clause but spelled 껐다 as 껤다; surface critic accepted the orthographic defect.
Model deleted unlicensed emotion and matched source fact.

witness_injection_stress.interpretation: A genuine Qwen response to critic-provided witnesses can pass the current mechanical protocol on seeded invalid inputs. This does not estimate spontaneous model repair or actual Korean quality gain.

positive: A finite Korean fact-slot G→V→(optional G)→V workflow can execute under prospective time and attempt budgets.
An independent deterministic assembler always produces two paragraphs for the prospective source slots.
Witness-only feedback can elicit model repairs when defects are artificially injected.
negative: 9/10 accepted clauses simply copied original facts, leaving the Korean naturalness objective untouched.
The real non-adversarial run had no repair cycles; GAN-like dynamic was not activated spontaneously.
3/3 known semantic contradictions were missed by the lexical critic.
A repaired clause with the orthographic form 껤다 passed, so mechanical acceptance does not certify idiomatic Korean.
Both documents fell below target length; two-paragraph format improvement is by construction and not a clean causal comparison to v0.1.
problem_court.corrective_research_direction: A Korean construction calculus with typed predicate-argument structure, polarity, comparison direction, tense/aspect, discourse warrants, context-licensed topic/focus, ellipsis and register/cadence. Each operation must declare preconditions and defeaters; evaluation must handle UNKNOWN explicitly and human naturalness externally.
problem_court.no_premature_fix: Do not add generic ungrounded synonym-change reward to punish copies; would incentivize unsupported changes. Do not retune on v0.2 or its injected stress cases as confirmatory evidence.
problem_court.future_comparison: Prospectively compare no-repair local slots vs witness repair vs untyped equal-budget plan vs monolithic baseline on NEW briefs, keeping a frozen independent fact check and blinded human reader judgment.
problem_court.human_reader_court: ON_HOLD_USER_RECRUITING; previous KRC v0.1 3-form/18-pair blinded materials retained, no participant results in this stage.
